_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 2, after V4 architecture freeze (commit 2f30bb0) -- documents created before any case queries were written, same corpus-first discipline as prior batches. New synthetic vendors only (VENDOR-5001..5003). Priorities for this tranche: (1) future-effective amendment asserted too early (taxonomy #21, exercises the new non_current-values-in-the-future-direction fix directly), (2) revoked-then-reinstated authority (first real exercise of TemporalStatus.REVOKED and the new `revokes` document field -- previously only hand-built in isolated gate tests), (3) wrong-vendor approval (an authority document that is genuine and correctly-scoped for one vendor being incorrectly treated as covering a different one), (4) multi-dimensional authority conjunction -- correct role, correct amount, wrong vendor, per directive Section 5/11.
